title: Invalid API key
message: Invalid API key. Keys start with `or-live-` and are created at {{SITE}}/keys, or with `POST /v1/keys`. A key from another gateway will not work here.
fix: Create a key at {{SITE}}/keys. Rotation with the recovery secret replaces the key immediately — there is no grace window, so swap it in one move.

title: No bearer token
message: Missing bearer token. Send your key as 'Authorization: Bearer or-live-...'.
fix: Send the header. A client that holds the key but omits it is almost always reading an unset environment variable — echo it before blaming the gateway.

title: Insufficient credit
message: Insufficient credit: this key's balance will not cover the request, so it was not sent and nothing was charged. Top up at {{SITE}}/pay
fix: Add credit. The message tells you which case you hit. A pre-request refusal names your balance and the worst-case estimate it could not cover, and nothing was sent or charged. A mid-stream stop names what the delivered tokens actually cost. The `x-onerouter-balance-usd` header on the 402 is the same available balance.

title: Unknown model
message: Unknown model 'claude-sonnet-5'. Did you mean 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-5'? Full list: {{API}}/catalog
fix: Use an id from the catalog, in author/name form. The suggestion is computed from the closest published id, so an agent can correct itself without a human.

title: All upstreams unavailable
message: All upstream hosts for 'meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct' are failing right now (we tried 3). Live status: {{SITE}}/status. Working alternatives at this moment: 'deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash', 'mistralai/mistral-nemo'.
fix: Retry, or switch to one of the named alternatives. Naming a live alternative inside the error is deliberate: an agent can act on it without a human reading a status page.

title: No model available for auto
message: 'onerouter/auto:code' has no model available for this request right now — every candidate was unavailable, not allowed on this key, or unable to price the request. Name a model directly, or retry shortly. Current picks: {{SITE}}/models/auto
fix: Auto walked its ordered list and every candidate failed one of three tests. The resolution table is public; pick a model by name to bypass the router entirely.

title: No Open Tier capacity
message: No verified free route is available. This request was not switched to a paid model and nothing was charged. Availability: {{SITE}}/models/auto/free
fix: Retry later. The Open Tier never falls back to paid, so adding credit will not resolve this — name a paid model explicitly if you need the request served now.

title: Open Tier allowance spent
message: Your Open Tier allowance is exhausted. Retry after the time in Retry-After. Quotas reset at 00:00 UTC.
fix: Wait for the reset. Every key on the account shares one allowance, so minting another key does not reset it, and adding credit does not raise it.

title: Rate limited
message: Rate limited: this key allows 60 requests/minute. Raise it at {{SITE}}/keys
fix: Back off for the number of seconds in Retry-After, then retry the identical request. The message names both the limit and the knob — a 429 that names neither is a dead end.

title: Budget spent
message: This request exceeds the daily cap on budget 'nightly-agents' ($20.00/day, $19.94 used). Review it at {{SITE}}/docs/budgets
fix: Raise the named budget or wait for its window to reset. Open reservations count immediately, so concurrent requests cannot bypass a cap a serial request would have hit.

title: Context too long
message: Request is 182,400 tokens but 'meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct' accepts 131,072. Models with larger context: {{SITE}}/models
fix: Shorten the prompt or pick a longer-context model. The counts are named so you can tell how far over you are without instrumenting your own tokenizer.

title: Request body too large
message: Request body exceeds the 10 MB limit.
fix: Trim the request. A body this size is almost always an accidentally inlined file or a runaway conversation history. The edge refuses it before reading it all rather than buffering it into memory.

title: Upstream error
message: The upstream returned an error after we had begun streaming, so we could not move to another host without corrupting the response. Live status: {{SITE}}/status
fix: Retry the request. If output had barely started — under 50 tokens — the charge is written off automatically rather than billed for a response you cannot use.

title: Request timed out
message: No first token from any upstream within 30s, across 3 hosts. Live status: {{SITE}}/status
fix: Retry. Before the first byte reaches you we can and do switch hosts automatically; after it, we cannot.

title: Invalid request
message: 'messages' must be a non-empty array. See {{SITE}}/docs/errors#invalid_request
fix: Check the field named in the message. On the Open Tier this also covers routing overrides — `models`, `provider`, `route`, `fallbacks` — which are refused rather than silently ignored. For base-URL mistakes, use {{API}} with no endpoint suffix.

title: Endpoint not served
message: Embeddings are not served by this gateway. OneRouter serves text generation only.
fix: Move to /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses or /v1/messages. Unsupported surfaces answer with a sentence rather than a 404 so a misconfigured client is told what to do instead of guessing.

title: Account suspended
message: This account is suspended. Contact {{SITE}}/support to resolve it.
fix: Contact support. Suspension follows a chargeback, a sanctions-screening hit, or an acceptable-use breach — the reply names which.

title: Unhandled error
fix: Retry, then report it with the receipt id from x-onerouter-receipt. This message carries no detail on purpose: an unhandled exception must never surface a stack frame that could carry prompt text into a response body or a log line.
